FASM skyline: a routed 7-series design as a city on the XC7A200T die

Drop a .fasm: every tile it configures becomes a column as tall as the features it sets, on the full XC7A200T grid. Counted in your browser; PNG to share.

A file you open here is read by your browser only: it is never uploaded. The page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

  • routed.fasm (sha256 daf92c6604a35eb3..., 206571 bytes): StreamTernaryMac, Verilog generated by t27_compiler.wasm (sha256 bb39b9a5ca412a26...) from specs/ternary/stream_ternary_mac.t27 (sha256 f46c60b0ba669110...); the build-receipt widget's run of 2026-10-04, recorded in public/widgets/build-receipt/receipt.json
